title: Pan-Baked Lemon Almond Tart
changes_from_base: A crustless lemon and almond batter cooked in a frying pan and finished in the oven, with no pastry or pears.
summary: A quick crustless lemon and almond tart cooked in a frying pan and browned under the grill.

ingredients.note: use up to 150 g if you like it sweeter

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
flaked almonds, plus 10 g to finish

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Whisk the eggs, sugar, salt, ground almonds, cream, 45 g flaked almonds and the lemon zest and juice together.

steps.title: Start on the hob
steps.text: melt the butter in the pan over low heat. Once the foam settles, pour in the batter and tilt to spread it, then cook until the edges begin to set. Keep the heat low so the base doesn’t scorch.

steps.title: Finish in the oven
steps.text: bake 10-15 min, until set in the middle.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: slide under a hot grill for about 1 min, until just golden. Watch it closely; it colours in seconds.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: dust with icing sugar, scatter the last almonds over and serve warm in wedges.

tips: Use a pan with a metal handle that can go in the oven and under the grill.
Keep the hob heat low while the edges set; the sugary almond batter scorches quickly on the base.
Serve with berries or thick yoghurt.
safety: Wear oven gloves when you take the pan out; the handle stays hot.
storage: Best eaten warm. Chill leftovers for up to 1 day.
